Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and great question!

Yes, when you're billed the full annual amount up front, that charge already includes the 20% discount compared to paying monthly. In other words, the annual plan price you were charged is 20% lower than what you'd pay if you were billed monthly for 12 months -- the discount is baked into the annual rate rather than shown as a separate line item.

If you'd like, I'm happy to pull up your account and send over a breakdown showing the monthly-equivalent rate versus what you were charged, so you can see the savings clearly. Just let me know!

Best,
